title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Orchard Hall, Tokyo | 2016
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Orchard Hall, part of the Bunkamura in Tokyo, Japan, on 1 November 2016.

It was the 33rd show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America and Asia, which lasted for 42 dates between June and November 2016, and the second of three consecutive nights at the Orchard Hall.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
